en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm pond or small lake with rowboats and people boating in the foreground. The opposite bank is lined with trees, behind which stands a building with two pointed towers. Benches and a path run along the waterfront. Printed caption text appears at the lower left, and handwritten purple and red ink messages and a date are on the lower part of the card.
